name: demo-radioset-enum
description: A radioset component displaying a set of unique values.

enumValues.description: A set of unique values, each one will be assigned as the value of an option

disabledValues.description: A set of unique values of the options which should be disabled

direction.description: Specifies the direction in which the options are to be rendered

labelledBy.description: The ID of an oj-label element associated with this component

describedBy.description: The ID of an oj-label element associated with this component.  Typically not set by an application, but by oj-label itself

labelHint.description: Represents a hint for oj-form-layout element to render a label on the editable component

disabled.description: Whether or not the entire radioset is disabled
